title: How do I schedule a wire-coil bell annealing furnace with one heating hood and two bases?
summary: Two furnace bases do not provide the capacity of two complete heating furnaces. A historical bell furnace proposal from Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. for bearing-steel wire coils specifies one heating hood, two sets of bases and retorts, and one cooling hood. Production planning must identify which batch occupies each hood and include loading, unloading, atmosphere changes and crane transfers in the same schedule.
